_about: Data for The Mobile Pods supplier showcase (suppliers/the-mobile-pods.html), read by supplier-preview-system/build-mobile-pods-showcase.py. Every fact restates what themobilepods.ie publishes (source page and check date per product). Images are hotlinked from images[].origin; images[].local are the review-bundle copies. To swap in the supplier's originals, update origin/w/h for the same slot id and rebuild.

intro: Timber-frame garden pods and compact garden homes, designed and built to order in Ireland — from a 21 m² studio with its own kitchen and shower room to bespoke one-off builds, including pods on wheels.
standfirst: The Mobile Pods build fully insulated timber-frame pods that arrive turnkey: kitchen, shower room, flooring and finishes in place, ready to connect. Two standard models set the starting point; most clients then change the windows, cladding, layout and finish.

products.name: Deluxe21
products.summary: A single-storey 21 m² pod with an open living space, a separate sleeping room and a full shower room.
specs: 100 mm, described as suitable for year-round use
A 2 m × 3 m window with integrated doors, plus a full-glass entrance door
Plasterboard or wood-clad walls; kitchen up to 2 m with appliances; shower room with toilet, sink and ventilation; 50 L electric water heater; electric towel warmer
Professional architectural drawings and a 3D visualisation
From €40,406 inc. VAT (turnkey), as published by the supplier

products.name: Deluxe25+
products.summary: A longer 24.5 m² pod that adds stairs to a loft level above the sleeping and shower rooms.
specs: 100 mm, described as comfortable in all seasons
A 2 m × 3 m window with integrated doors, plus a full-glass entrance door

Plasterboard or wood-clad walls; kitchen up to 2 m with appliances; flooring on both levels; stairs to the loft; shower room with toilet, sink and ventilation; 50 L electric water heater; electric towel warmer
Professional architectural drawings and a 3D visualisation
From €48,152.37 inc. VAT (turnkey), as published by the supplier

products.name: Custom builds
products.summary: One-off pods designed around the site and the brief — studios, offices, relaxation rooms, extensions and compact homes.
specs: C24 impregnated, calibrated timber, cut on CNC machinery
Fully customisable design, finishes and features
A free consultation and 3D design preview from the supplier

alsoMakes: The Mobile Pods also build saunas, hot tubs and cold-water tubs to order (no models or prices published).
costNote: Published starting prices exclude foundations (ground screws, concrete poles, slab or blocks, depending on the soil), transport to the site and connection to water, sewage and electricity. Changes to windows, finishes or layout can change the price.
planningNote: The supplier's pages state that no building permit is required up to 25 m². Whether planning permission is needed depends on how the pod will be used and where it sits: Ireland's exemption for garden buildings does not extend to use as a separate home. Check your plans with your local authority before you commit.
